recap.analyst:
Guanabara FC and Montaña CF drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.19–0.05: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Guanabara FC had 63% of the ball. Pass completion GUA 86% (200/233), MON 74% (100/136). Shots 1–1, on target 1–0.

Guanabara FC started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Montaña CF in a 4-3-3 (balanced). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 17': Guanabara FC levelled the match through J. Serchard. The chance was worth xG 0.19 (about 19 in 100 go in), struck at 72 km/h. Score now GUA 1-1 MON.

By the numbers: G. Lunholm completed the most passes (38); N. Chalaine hit the top speed (33.5 km/h); B. Vladtek covered the most ground (6.17 km, a 17.3 km per-90 pace); B. Vladtek won the most challenges (15).

Discipline: fouls 4–5, yellows 0–3, offsides 0–1. Conditions: partly cloudy, 27°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Guanabara, Rio de Janeiro. An own goal opened the scoring in the 7th minute, and Montaña CF were ahead. J. Serchard struck in the 17th for Guanabara FC. Guanabara FC had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: J. Serchard, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
